concepts.gloss_en: The union (yichud) of the Holy One, blessed be He, and His Shekhinah — the act/state of unification
The Holy One, blessed be He (the divine referent itself), not the act of union

members.note: Names the divine entity, not the yichud; an action/state about X is not X (rule 4). Kept separate from the union concept.

concepts.canonical_he: יחוד קדשא בריך הוא ושכינתה אפין באפין
concepts.gloss_en: The face-to-face (apin b'apin) union of the Holy One and His Shekhinah — a specific mode/quality of the union, distinct from the unqualified yichud

members.form: יחוד קדשא בריך הוא ושכינתה אפין באפין
members.note: representative; 'apin b'apin' specifies a particular mode of union

notes: Under-merge applied. Form 2 (קדשא בריך הוא) names the divine entity itself, not the union — rule 4. Form 3 adds 'apin b'apin' (face-to-face), a distinct qualifier specifying the manner of union; kept separate rather than merged into the general yichud concept. A reviewer may consider whether form 3 should be a sub-type of concept 1.
